faq.title: Questions about using SpotGo
faq.description: Answers for Drivers and Parking Admins.
faq.find.question: How do I find available parking?
faq.find.answer: In SpotGo Driver, explore nearby parking zones, check availability and rates, and review the details before choosing where to park.
faq.reserve.question: How do I make a reservation?
faq.reserve.answer: Choose an available zone and space, select your vehicle and schedule, review the amount, and confirm. You can check your reservation details in the app.
faq.change.question: Can I change or cancel a reservation?
faq.change.answer: Changes, extensions, and cancellations depend on availability and the conditions shown for your reservation. Review those conditions before confirming a change.
faq.adminTools.question: What can I manage with SpotGo Parking Admin?
faq.adminTools.answer: Review occupancy and zone or space status, follow operational alerts, and access the parking infrastructure tools assigned to your location.
faq.adminAccess.question: How do I get access to Parking Admin?
faq.adminAccess.answer: Parking Admin is for authorized parking staff. An administrator for your organization must enable your account; public registration is for Drivers.

privacy.description: Learn how SpotGo handles personal information across its mobile apps and landing page.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.heading: Introduction
privacy.intro.body: This Privacy Policy explains how SpotGo handles personal information when you use the SpotGo Driver and SpotGo Parking Admin mobile apps and related services. It also describes the language preference stored by this landing page.
privacy.collect.heading: Information We Collect
privacy.collect.body: Depending on your role and how you use SpotGo, information may include details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, account information, vehicle details, reservations, payment method or transaction information, and information submitted while managing parking operations. We may also collect device and service usage information, including parking activity.
privacy.use.heading: How We Use Information
privacy.use.body: We use information to provide and maintain SpotGo, support accounts, parking searches, reservations and payments, display operational information, send service and security notices, protect users, and improve the apps and related services.
privacy.share.heading: Information Sharing
privacy.share.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers who help operate SpotGo, when disclosure is required by law, when needed to protect rights or safety, or as you direct.
privacy.security.heading: Data Security
privacy.security.body: We use safeguards intended to protect information. No method of transmitting or storing information can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
privacy.retention.heading: Data Retention
privacy.retention.body: We retain information for as long as needed to provide SpotGo and meet legal, accounting, security, dispute resolution, and operational requirements. You may contact us to request deletion. Some information may be retained where the law permits or requires it.
privacy.rights.heading: Your Rights
privacy.rights.body: Depending on applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information. Contact us at privacy@spotgo.com to make a request.
privacy.storage.heading: Cookies and Local Storage
privacy.storage.body: This landing page stores your selected language (en_US or es_419) in your browser's local storage on this device so the page can reopen in that language. The mobile apps and related services may store information needed for sessions, account security, and preferences.
privacy.changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
privacy.changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version here and update the date above when it changes.
privacy.contact.heading: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us at privacy@spotgo.com.

terms.accounts.body: Access depends on your role. Drivers may register for and use a Driver account. Parking Admin accounts are provided for authorized parking operations. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and notifying us promptly if you suspect unauthorized use.
terms.use.heading: Acceptable Use
terms.use.body: You agree not to misuse SpotGo, interfere with its operation, access information or locations without authorization, or attempt to bypass security controls.
terms.parking.heading: Parking and Reservations
terms.parking.body: Parking availability, rates, and operating rules may vary by parking location. Availability is not guaranteed until a reservation is confirmed in the Driver app. Charges, cancellations, and refunds follow the conditions shown for each reservation; fees are non-refundable unless those conditions or applicable law state otherwise.
terms.admin.heading: Parking Admin Tools
terms.admin.body: Parking Admin features are for users authorized to manage their assigned parking operations. You are responsible for using those tools only within your authorized scope and for the information you submit.
